title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - AI Products Remote)
description: Role : Senior Full Stack Engineer - AI Products Remote) Location : Remote (Work from Anywhere) Job Type : Contract Payout : $30 - $90/hour Role Overview: We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to work on a contract basis. Key Responsibilities: • Design, develop, and deploy full stack web applications using modern frameworks and technologies. • Lead architectural decisions to ensure scalability, reliability, and security of the platform. • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code while adhering to best practices. • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the stack. • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to code reviews to maintain high development standards. Required Skills & Qualifications: • Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks such as React or Vue.js. • Experience with backend development in Node.js, Python, or similar languages. • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and database design. • Knowledge of DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and cloud platforms like AWS or Azure. • Experience with testing frameworks and automated testing strategies. More About the Opportunity: This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Software Development industry, contributing to the evolution of a high-performance platform serving thousands of users. The contract position provides flexibility to work from anywhere while solving complex technical challenges. Equal Opportunity Employer: We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications. Apply Now!
